IEPI.description: Ignore Elements for Nonlinear Analysis Initial Load (IEPI). Keyed by element number; each entry carries the single flag that controls whether that element is excluded from the nonlinear analysis initial load stage.

B_IGNORE.description: When true, the element (identified by the map key) is ignored for the nonlinear analysis initial load. Optional; defaults to false.

manual_title: Ignore Elements for Pushover Intial Load
